source.author: verg
source.text: Ante urbem pueri et primaevo flore iuventus exercentur equis domitantque in pulvere currus aut acris tendunt arcus aut lenta lacertis spicula contorquent cursuque ictuque lacessunt:
source.text_original: Ante urbem pueri et primaevo flore iuventus / exercentur equis domitantque in pulvere currus / aut acris tendunt arcus aut lenta lacertis / spicula contorquent cursuque ictuque lacessunt: /
source.text_english: Before the city, boys and youths in the prime of life are trained on horseback and tame chariots in the dust, or they bend taut bows, or whirl light spears with their arms, and in running and striking they challenge one another:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Omnis avet quae iam bellis spectataque fama turba ducum, primae seu quos in flore iuventae temptamenta tenent necdum data copia rerum:
reuse.text_original: Omnis avet quae iam bellis spectataque fama / turba ducum, primae seu quos in flore iuventae / temptamenta tenent necdum data copia rerum: /
reuse.text_english: All the whole crowd of leaders, already famed and tested in wars, whether those whom the first bloom of youth still holds in their first attempts and to whom no full opportunity has yet been given, longs for it.
